On 18 Oct 2026 the owner said "yes, add the rules and build all the gaps", which covers every gap between the picked round 19 drawing ("The SAP way", both scenes) and HaTi. On 17 Oct the overnight build had left four parts of round 19 out and kept two earlier rulings instead. This lane built all of them on A1's shared Jambo panel.

- **LABELS ABOVE THE BOXES.** The drawing sets each filter's word above its box under a hairline. The band's filters now sit outside `.reg-tabbar`, so the house rule `.sap-page .reg-fb .reg-chip` puts the word above the box. This reverses the 10 Oct "label inside" for this band only; Contracts and Negotiations keep theirs.
- **A CITY NEEDED A HOME, AND GOT ONE.** HaTi kept no city, and no one contract is the right place for a party's city. So a party's own facts (city, organisation no.) now live in one server table, `party_records`, keyed as Parties keys a party (`cuKeyOf`). There is one writer (PUT /api/party-records, an editor's). The wall is `prVisibleKeys`: a reader is told only about parties named on contracts they may open, and never about a party that stands only on a confidential deal they are outside of. A refused write is a 404, as everywhere. Every change goes into `party_record_log` and shows in the trail as "Party details", but only where the trail reaches a contract with that party, and never for a code-named deal's party seen from outside. Nothing is guessed. The parties clause is OFFERED under the City box: the party's own address row first, then the sentence after its name. The city it offers is the address's last part that is a place name, never a box, number, postcode or country (the browser's own list of countries, `Intl.DisplayNames`). The suggestion fills the box only when pressed, and nothing is saved until Save.
- **STATUS IS THE PARTY'S STANDING.** The drawing opens on Live yet still shows a live party's ended agreements, so Status now chooses PARTIES (`cuStanding`) and no longer narrows the contracts a row counts. Stream and Owner still narrow, and the row, its sub-line, the panel and the doors still count the same set.
